definition.en: The attachment traditionally called the starting end; which end stays still depends on the task.
definition.zh: 传统上称为肌肉起始端的附着；哪一端保持不动取决于任务。

definition.en: The attachment traditionally called the destination end; it can be fixed while the other end moves.
definition.zh: 传统上称为肌肉终止端的附着；也可以固定这一端，让另一端移动。

definition.en: A broad, flat tendon sheet transmitting muscle tension to other tissues.
definition.zh: 把肌肉张力传给其他组织的宽阔、扁平腱性薄片。

definition.en: The midline connective-tissue seam where abdominal aponeuroses meet; it does not actively contract.
definition.zh: 两侧腹壁腱膜在前正中线汇合形成的结缔组织带，不会主动收缩。

definition.en: The tendon envelope around rectus abdominis, formed by the lateral abdominal aponeuroses; its arrangement varies with height.
definition.zh: 侧腹肌腱膜形成、包住腹直肌的腱性鞘，其排列随高度变化。

definition.en: Connective-tissue layers of the back that provide attachments and transmit tension between muscle groups.
definition.zh: 背部的结缔组织层，为肌群提供附着并在它们之间传递张力。

definition.en: A prominence on the proximal medial femur receiving the iliopsoas tendon.
definition.zh: 股骨近端内侧的骨性突起，接收髂腰肌腱。

definition.en: Bringing the thigh towards the trunk at the hip joint; this is distinct from bending the spine.
definition.zh: 在髋关节处把大腿带向躯干，区别于脊柱弯曲。

definition.en: Producing muscle tension with little change in muscle length; a still position can require substantial effort.
definition.zh: 肌肉长度基本不变时仍产生张力；静止姿态也可能需要较大用力。

definition.en: Resisting an external tendency to arch the trunk backwards, as in a controlled plank.
definition.zh: 抵抗外力造成躯干后仰的趋势，例如有控制的平板支撑。

definition.en: Resisting an external tendency to twist the trunk, as in a Pallof press.
definition.zh: 抵抗外力造成躯干扭转的趋势，例如抗旋转推。

definition.en: Tilting the trunk and pelvis through hip motion while keeping the spine close to its intended shape.
definition.zh: 通过髋运动让躯干与骨盆前倾，脊柱尽量维持原定形状。

definition.en: Low back pain for which a specific disease or structural cause cannot confidently be identified; the pain is real.
definition.zh: 不能明确用特定疾病或结构原因解释的腰痛；疼痛本身是真实的。
